subject: problem running rattle on Win7 x64

messages.author: 483cd9333751ded0
messages.subject: problem running rattle on Win7 x64
parts:
rattle-users,

trying to run rattle() gives the following error mesage:

> library(rattle)
Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.
Version 2.6.8 Copyright (c) 2006-2011 Togaware Pty Ltd.
Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
> rattle()
Error in inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...) :
unable to load shared object 'c:/R/libuser/RGtk2/libs/x64/RGtk2.dll':
LoadLibrary failure: The device is not ready.


I saw mention of release of RGtk2_2.20.16 which it was hoped would
resolve this problem. However, I still get the error message. When I
look for the dll mentioned, I find it in the specified location. My
sessionInfo() output is included below. Any suggestions about how to
proceed would be greatly appreciated.

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.13.1 (2011-07-08)
Platform: x86_64-pc-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252
[2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252

attached base packages:
[1] stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods base

other attached packages:
[1] RGtk2_2.20.16 rattle_2.6.8
>


Dan

Daniel Nordlund
Bothell, WA USA

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: problem running rattle on Win7 x64
parts:
Thanks for the feedback Daniel. 

That's a pity - this is a really odd issue - but not one everyone is having the same issue.

If we can somehow work out why it works for some and not for others we might be able to find a fix. 

Any suggestions are most welcome.

Regards,
Graham
